program.section_heading: Fine Arts: Emphasis in Photography AA
program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Create photographs that visually communicate ideas and concepts while engaging the practices, theories, and materials of the medium.
Critically analyze and assess diverse historical and contemporary visual art works and apply those conclusions to the creation of compelling photographs.

Demonstrate advanced skills in dry (digital) and wet (analog) darkroom methods as well as commercial studio techniques. Master the basics of digital photo processing and presentation of photographs through current computer software methods.
Demonstrate a command of the fundamental controls of the camera and be able to employ those skills in capturing photos in different lighting conditions, shooting environments, and time constraints.
Present commercially viable visual art works for peer, professional or academic review.

notes: The catalog groups Art/Media (6 units) and Art History (3 units) under an 'Electives' heading with a printed total of 9 units; recorded as two choose_units blocks.
ART51/MEDIA14 and ART53/MEDIA10 are cross-listed; the catalog notes cross-listed courses meet a requirement for only one subject area, so each pair is recorded as one entry with an alternative.
Degree total of 60 taken from the header '25.0 Major Units | 60 Total Units Required' printed for this award; no GE unit total is printed.
Student completes either the CC-GE or the Cal-GETC pattern.
Codes recorded as printed without spaces (e.g., ART2, MEDIA12).
